# An immutable monetary amount, stored as an integer number of cents.
class Money
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :cents, :currency

  def initialize(cents, currency = "USD")
    raise ArgumentError, "cents must be an Integer" unless cents.is_a?(Integer)
    unless currency.is_a?(String) && currency.match?(/\A[A-Za-z]{3}\z/)
      raise ArgumentError, "currency must be a three-letter code"
    end

    @cents = cents
    @currency = currency.upcase.freeze
    freeze
  end

  # Amounts in different currencies cannot be ordered without an exchange rate.
  def <=>(other)
    return nil unless other.is_a?(Money) && currency == other.currency

    cents <=> other.cents
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Money) && cents == other.cents && currency == other.currency
  end
  alias eql? ==

  def hash
    [cents, currency].hash
  end

  def format
    sign = cents.negative? ? "-" : ""
    units, remainder = cents.abs.divmod(100)
    prefix = currency == "USD" ? "$" : "#{currency} "
    "#{sign}#{prefix}#{units}.#{remainder.to_s.rjust(2, '0')}"
  end
  alias to_s format
end
